sloka: फलमूलाशनो भूत्वा जटी चीरधरस्तथा ।अनुभूयेदृशं दुःखमेष राघवनन्दनः ।प्रेष्ये मयि स्थिते राजन्न भूयः क्लेशमाप्नुयात् ।। ७.६२.१४ ॥
transliteration: phalamūlāśano bhūtvā jaṭī cīradharastathā ।anubhūyedṛśaṁ duḥkhameṣa rāghavanandanaḥ ।preṣye mayi sthite rājanna bhūyaḥ kleśamāpnuyāt ।। 7.62.14 ॥

translations.english: Bharata, having become an ascetic eating fruits and roots, with matted hair and bark garments, and having experienced such sorrow, should not again suffer while I, your servant, am present, O King.
